parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is tier-1 state-imposed universal exposure: a 2026 statute forces birth-sex facility use, barring trans women from shelters and placing inmates by birth sex, on top of a live indecent-exposure definition for using the matching bathroom (enforcement unquantified). Compounding it, an enforceable criminal ban on gender-expressive performance carries up to ~12 months (felony on repeat), and the parent border regime refuses documents with sex discrepancies, has detained travellers, and can attach lifetime fraud ineligibility — a real entry exposure for anyone whose papers mismatch. Recourse is weak: no state gender-identity hate-crime coverage, panic defence intact, 2021 reports of police indifference. Mitigating: no documented police sweeps or extortion of visibly trans people, no evidence of an organised campaign, and the 7.8/100k killing figure is an admitted undercount floor, so the violence axis is treated as unassessed rather than elevated. Sits below 0.35's facility-only profiles, above 0.25's organised coercion.
